label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE
principle: Mirror B1.12's most reliable signal: honestly emitting 'does not apply' beats forcing a link. Every stage may abstain; abstention propagates and the symbolic layer contributes nothing rather than fabricating.

signals.condition: no frozen-ontology concern scores at or above the extraction confidence threshold, OR the input carries no reflective concern (factual/transactional turn).
signals.effect: bridge halts; status=NO_APPLICABLE_CONCERN; no concept, no varna, no reflection.

signals.condition: the selected concern has no entry in the frozen concern->concept table (or all candidates are marked non-mappable).
signals.effect: bridge halts; status=NO_APPLICABLE_CONCEPT; mirrors B1.12 no_relationship. Never force a concept.

signals.condition: the concept word parses but has zero CONFIRMATORY_BACKBONE mapped consonants.
signals.effect: bridge halts; status=NO_MAPPED_VARNA; no reflection synthesized.

signals.condition: aggregate confidence below the deployment floor (e.g. no Tier-1 mapping present AND extraction confidence low).
signals.effect: reflection may be withheld or surfaced only as a low-confidence, clearly-hedged aside, per deployment policy.

invariant: Silent forcing is prohibited at every stage. Abstention is a first-class, logged outcome, not an error.
